metricDefinitions.aggregate_output_tokens_per_second: overall: completion tokens divided by the sum of measured round spans (end-to-end, includes prefill and queueing)
metricDefinitions.aggregate_total_tokens_per_second: overall: actual prefill plus completion tokens divided by the sum of measured round spans; other statistics describe individual rounds
metricDefinitions.completion_sha256: SHA-256 of generated text for cross-concurrency exactness checks; generated text itself is omitted
metricDefinitions.decode_tokens_per_second: completion tokens divided by server decode time
metricDefinitions.draft_acceptance: accepted support-model tokens divided by drafted support-model tokens
metricDefinitions.matchedRoundOutputTokensPerSecond: aggregate output tokens per second over rounds whose completions all matched the reference hashes
metricDefinitions.prefill_tokens_per_second: actual server prefill tokens divided by server prefill time

notes: AR workload measured once per concurrency: repetition_word, 128 output tokens. Moved from the prior repetition table; timings are unchanged.
